title: List page
description: A 1.0 records page on Page layout="work": 18/400 title row with an inverse action, StickyContextBar with SearchPill + FilterChipRow (sort, Chọn and in-place selection mode on the filter row; PhoneFilterBar on phones; no result-count row), DataTable / Card grid / phone Item rows sharing the same selection model, and DetailOverlay (?open=). Copy it with `semi add list-page`.
when: Orders, customers, products, jobs: any page whose job is to find and act on records.

instead.need: Entities people recognise by image and status
A page with one or two filters and no search

a11y: The title row is the page h1 with its action; the bar under it is a search landmark named for the page; the table has a caption; bulk actions appear as a labelled region.
Views are toggle buttons (Pills) on md+ and radio items of a menu on phones; a single-choice filter chip opens a menu of radio items.
